title: The Global Wireless
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: The Global Wireless charts a history of wireless beginning in the 1910s, when it was used as a tool for global communication, and ending as it declined and slowly fell from view after World War I. Examining the political negotiations and international communication networks, the book demonstrates how a wireless technology had already spread around the globe a century ago and prompted a radical reconsideration of networked communication.
